name: expense_tracker
description: The rewrite removes the hourly exchange-rate cache, so every conversion runs a fresh exchange_rates lookup, including repeated lookups for the same currency pair inside the report loop.
flaw: The ExchangeRateCache class and the rate_cache instance were deleted from db.py, and get_rate in main.py no longer consults any cache: every conversion calls fetch_latest_rate, and handle_report issues one DB query per expense row, so a report over thousands of entries repeats identical lookups for the same pairs.
